title: walk.rs: in_alternative nullification fires for inline media types too
description: walk.rs lines 129-134: when in_alternative=true and the current multipart is not 'alternative', text/plain sets html_body=None and text/html sets text_body=None. RFC 8621 §4.1.4 specifies the JS 'if (textBody) { htmlBody = null; }' fires for *any* isInline part in this context (not just text/plain and text/html). Inline media types (image/*, audio/*, video/*) go through the is_inline=true path and reach the push-to-both block, but they do not trigger the nullification. Per RFC 8621 §4.1.4 the nullification should happen for all is_inline parts encountered inside a non-alternative multipart within an alternative, not only for text/plain and text/html specifically.
close_reason: RFC 8621 §4.1.4 pseudocode (line 2217-2224) only nullifies for text/plain and text/html — inline media types don't trigger nullification. Code is correct.
